title: Stebin Ben breaks silence on viral video of his mother ignoring Nupur Sanon: 'Chalo nikalte hain' | Bollywood
text:
'Media hai, chalo nikalte hain'
In a recent interaction, Stebin defended his mother and cleared the air around the viral moment. He told Galatta India, "My parents are very simple people. Whenever they see the media, they quietly move away because they feel that the media is there for me, not for them. They think, 'This is your profession. People want to see you, not us.' My parents didn't know the media was standing there. The moment they saw the flashlights, they just started walking ahead. I told them, 'It's okay, you go ahead, we'll come behind.' Nupur tried to stop them, but they didn't even realise someone was calling them. They just thought, 'Media hai, chalo nikalte hain.'"
